title: Lucky Thompson's hair straightener burns when the hotel water is cut off
summary: In St. Louis Lucky runs across the street in shorts with lye in his hair and ends up with bald patches, mocked by the band.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: But Lucky kind of stood out, because he was straight. And one morning, we were in St. Louis, the same place, during the same time I was speaking of before. And we all lived in this hotel on one floor. And this fellow who ran the hotel was a Jewish fellow. One morning, something alarmed the hotel with this loud scream, and then cussin' in the hall. And everybody looked out their door, and there's Lucky Thompson standing up in his shorts, and this towel around his shoulders, and all this goo on his hair, and he's cussin' this Jewish owner like crazy. I never heard Lucky cuss like that before. He called him all kinds of names. And the Jew was trying to tell him...
What it turned out to be was that when you put this stuff

on your hair... At that particular time, they used lye in it. And that I guess was what the straightener was. When you put it on your hair, the first thing you did, you put a lot of Vaseline on your hair and then you put this stuff in to keep it from burning. But you could only let it stay on for a certain length of time, and then you had to wash it out. Lucky Thompson got up early that morning and was going to do his hair, and got this stuff in his hair before he realized that they had cut the water off in the hotel temporarily for some reason or other. And when he went to the turn the water on, there's no water. He's got this stuff on his hair and it's burning him up. And he's telling this Jew to do something, "You so-and-so-and-so..."

So we came out, and somebody suggested first to stick his head in the commode. So someone else said, "No. There's another hotel across the street." So he ran across the street, because their water isn't cut off. And it was during the morning rush. We lived on one of the main streets. And it was during the morning, so people are going to work, you know. So he runs across the street in his shorts and this towel into the hotel, and got this stuff washed out of his head. But by the time he got the stuff washed out of his hair, there were bald patches all over his head! So a lot of the guys in the and were sniggering and laughing at Lucky and
giving him a hard time, like "You're so straight" -- he got kind of whittled down to size. Which I felt sorry for him, really.
